meta.name: The AWS provider is pinned to a bounded version range

evaluators.description: version_constraint must carry an upper bound -- '~> 5.0' or an explicit '< 6.0'. A bare '>= 5.0' lets a major release in on a Monday morning, and provider majors rewrite resource schemas: the plan that follows is full of replacements nobody asked for. This is a fact about the provider block, not about any one resource, which is why a per-resource policy engine has nowhere to put it.
